name: Click, swipe&wipe!
author: pablowunderlich
description:
Click, swipe and wipe! Destroy the boxes and avoid the bombs. Choose your difficulty and replay. This demo has interactive music and sfx created with scripts. My name is Pablo and I'm a game sound designer. In this case I composed and created the sfx, and then implemented the audio with custom scripts for a unique experience. Enjoy!
